battle.name: 奈及利亞內戰
battle.theater: 尼日爾河三角洲與東南戰線
battle.brief: 1967年7月6日聯邦軍自阿薩巴強渡尼日爾河向恩古推進，比夫拉軍節節抵抗；1968年後成批運抵的蘇制卡莫夫突擊步槍成為比夫拉城防與叢林伏擊的骨幹，聯邦軍則以FN FAL及英美製步槍正面壓制並逐步奪回恩古，最終在1970年1月攻佔蒙羅比亞，迫使比夫拉簽署終戰文件。

kit.name: 卡莫夫突擊步槍
kit.history: AK-47是蘇聯制式突擊步槍，隸屬步兵分隊的輕武器系統，擔任班與排的自動射擊火力，位階低於通用機槍與火炮。

countries: 1967年爆發的奈及利亞內戰，實質是聯邦政府與其東部邊疆一個分離政權之間的全面內戰。聯邦一方：1966年1月15日軍事政變推翻民選的巴萊瓦政府，同年7月北方軍人推翻加冕的總統，聯邦自此由北方軍人組成的最高軍事委員會主宰，陸軍總司令雅庫布·戈萬全權指揮東南戰區；軍隊以步兵師、裝甲營、空降旅與海空軍部隊編成，兵源以北部與西部為主，可沿拉各斯—卡諾鐵路與公路線迅速調動；英國、美國先後供應武器、運輸與情報協助，法國與以色列經中間商售出槍械，蘇聯自1968年起直接交付軍火。分離一方：比夫拉共和國於1967年7月6日在恩古宣布成立，疆域為東部三省，即後來的阿比亞、阿南比、伊莫、埃博尼與恩古，軍隊由原駐紮東部的聯邦軍部隊、地方警察與民兵改編，設第一、第二、第三師及民兵總隊，另有由埃豐貢掌握的少量艦艇組成的分遣艦隊；外來支持來自法國、捷克斯洛伐克、蘇聯、中國與瑞典民間援助，比夫拉流亡政府後來設於貝寧帕拉庫。第三方方面，加納、象牙海岸、喀麥隆、剛果（金沙薩）與坦桑尼亞等非洲國家在領空、後勤與外交上各有立場，聯合國曾派代表團赴比夫拉實地查訪，仍未能促成停火。
countriesEn: The Nigerian Civil War of 1967 was in substance a full-scale civil war between the federal government and a separatist polity on its eastern frontier. On the federal side, the military coup of 15 January 1966 overthrew the elected Balewa government, and in July of the same year northern officers removed the crowned president, after which the federation was run by a Supreme Military Council composed of northern army officers; Lieutenant General Yakubu Gowon as commander-in-chief of the army exercised overall authority over the south-eastern theatre. The federal army was organised into infantry divisions, armoured battalions, an airborne brigade and naval and air units, with recruitment drawn mainly from the north and west, and it could be shifted rapidly along the Lagos–Kano railway and the road net. Britain and the United States supplied weapons, transport and intelligence assistance in turn, France and Israel sold arms through intermediaries, and from 1968 the Soviet Union delivered matériel directly. On the side of the separatists, the Republic of Biafra was proclaimed at Enugu on 6 July 1967, holding the three eastern provinces that later became Abia, Anambra, Imo, Ebonyi and Enugu. Its army was rebuilt from federal units already stationed in the east, together with the regional police and the militia, and was organised into the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Divisions plus a militia command, with a small flotilla under Effiong forming the naval arm. Outside support came from France, Czechoslovakia, the Soviet Union, China and private Swedish aid, and the Biafran government-in-exile later sat in Parakou, in present-day Benin. Among the third parties, Ghana, the Ivory Coast, Cameroon, the Congo and Tanzania each took positions on airspace, logistics and diplomacy, and a United Nations mission visited Biafra without achieving a ceasefire.
people: 聯邦方面的總指揮是雅庫布·戈萬：他在1966年政變之後以北方軍人身份進入最高軍事委員會，1967年被任命為聯邦軍總司令，東南戰線每一次攻勢都出在其授權之下；北師師長奧盧塞貢·奧巴桑喬上校以分隊穿插與追擊作戰，逐步晉升為將軍，1975年政變後接掌國家。聯邦空軍承擔制空與對地攻擊，早期曾因地面引導與情報不足而在烏里機場附近失準。分離方面的領袖是原聯邦軍第三師師長奧朱古：1967年5月他以拒絕交出武器被捕並被判死刑，7月6日在恩古廣播宣布東部獨立，自號比夫拉比亞，1968年1月改稱總統。他的核心將佐包括參謀長兼海軍指揮官菲利普·埃豐貢、第一師師長哈桑·卡蒂納上校、第三師師長大衛·埃朱爾上校與第四師師長維克多·烏卡瓦上校；1970年1月1日烏卡瓦在蒙羅比亞的空襲中陣亡，1月4日埃朱爾所部與港口守軍投降，1月11日至12日埃豐貢在恩古簽署終戰文件，而6日已飛往象牙海岸的奧朱古，到12月才正式向聯邦軍投降。國際與民間方面，瑞典飛行員卡爾·古斯塔夫·馮·羅森駕駛自購機件與轟炸機執行從聖多美到比夫拉的秘密空運，把步槍、迫擊砲與地雷空投到比夫拉空場，使比夫拉擁有一支可自主運作的空中打擊力量。
peopleEn: On the federal side the overall commander was Yakubu Gowon, who entered the Supreme Military Council as a northern army officer after the 1966 coups and was appointed commander-in-chief of the armed forces in 1967, with every south-eastern operation authorised under him. Olusegun Obasanjo, then a colonel commanding a division in the north, fought with aggressive bounding and pursuit, rose to general rank, and took over the country after the 1975 coup. The federal air force carried the air-superiority and ground-attack burden; in the opening phase its strikes were inaccurate because of poor ground control and intelligence. The leader of the separatists was Ojukwu, formerly commander of the federal 3rd Division. Arrested in May 1967 for refusing to hand over his weapons and sentenced to death, he broadcast from Enugu on 6 July the independence of the eastern provinces, styling himself head of state, and in January 1968 took the title of president. His principal officers included the chief of staff and naval commander Philip Effiong, Colonel Hassan Katsina commanding the 1st Division, Colonel David Ejoor of the 3rd Division and Colonel Victor Ukaoha of the 4th Division. Ukaoha was killed in an air raid on Port Harcourt on 1 January 1970; on 4 January Ejoor and the port garrison surrendered; between 11 and 12 January Effiong signed the end-of-war document at Enugu, while Ojukwu, who had already flown to the Ivory Coast on the 6th, did not surrender formally until December. On the international and private side, the Swedish pilot Carl Gustaf von Rosen flew his own transport and a bomber on the secret air run from São Tomé to Biafra, dropping rifles, mortars and mines onto Biafran airfields and giving the republic a small but self-reliant air striking arm.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是蘇聯製卡莫夫突擊步槍，即AK-47，1949年定型，口徑7.62毫米，30發弧形彈匣，全自動與半自動可換，操作簡單、零件少、耐泥沙，最能適應比夫拉的雨林、沼澤與鄉村道路。在本役中它有兩條脈絡清楚的來源。第一條是比夫拉一側：1967年7月開戰時，比夫拉軍手上幾乎沒有蘇制武器，初期以繳獲的比利時FN FAL、英國李—恩菲爾德，以及英國政府同年移交的一萬支短彈匣李—恩菲爾德步槍應急；蘇制武器要到1968年下半年才經捷克斯洛伐克、法國與蘇聯的渠道連續成批運抵，空投落地後由游擊隊分散帶走。AK-47因而在1969年成為比夫拉城防與伏擊的骨幹：城區民兵用它守巷戰與屋頂陣位，叢林游擊隊用它打伏擊與急襲，火箭筒配屬到排。缺點同樣明顯，7.62毫米子彈在斷補的環境裡極難補充，備件與油料短缺使大批AK淪為啞鐵，殺傷力受制於補給線多過火力本身。第二條是聯邦一側：聯邦軍標準步槍是比利時FN FAL，配20發直彈匣，另有英製斯特林衝鋒槍、勃朗寧自動步槍與美製M1卡賓槍，砲兵有105毫米野戰砲與裝甲車支援；1968年後蘇聯直接向聯邦交付蘇制AK-47、RPG-7與122毫米榴炮，使聯邦軍在1970年前後換裝到與比夫拉相同的蘇制武庫。除步槍外，比夫拉大量使用土炸藥地雷、鐵絲網與竹木拒馬，並繳獲四○乘三砲、二○砲與車載發射器；兩軍的運輸都靠卡車、摩托車與人力獨木舟，燃料與輪胎是比槍更緊的瓶頸。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Soviet Kalashnikov assault rifle, the AK-47, adopted in 1949, chambered for the 7.62mm cartridge, fed by a 30-round curved magazine, with switchable full and semi-automatic fire, simple handling, few parts and a tolerance for mud and sand, which suited the rainforest, the swamps and the laterite roads of Biafra better than anything else in the inventory. In this war it arrived along two clearly traceable channels. The first is the Biafran side: at the opening of the fighting in July 1967 the secessionist army held almost no Soviet weapons and relied on captured Belgian FN FAL rifles, British Lee-Enfields, and the ten thousand short Lee-Enfield rifles the British government handed over in the same year. Soviet material only began to arrive in continuous bulk consignments in the second half of 1968 through Czechoslovak, French and Soviet channels, dropped by air and then dispersed by the guerrilla bands. The AK-47 accordingly became the backbone of Biafran city defence and ambush work in 1969: militia in the towns used it for street fighting and rooftop positions, while the jungle companies used it for ambush and raid, with rocket launchers issued down to platoon level. The weaknesses were just as clear. 7.62mm ammunition was almost impossible to replace in a broken supply system, and shortages of spare parts and lubricants left large numbers of rifles inert, so the weapon's effect was limited more by the supply line than by its own rate of fire. The second channel is the federal side. The standard federal rifle was the Belgian FN FAL with 20-round magazines, supported by the Sterling submachine gun, the Browning automatic rifle and surplus American M1 Garands, with 105mm field guns and armoured vehicles in the artillery arm. From 1968 the Soviet Union delivered AK-47s, RPG-7 launchers and 122mm howitzers direct to the federal government, so that by 1970 the federal army was being re-equipped from the same Soviet arsenal that supplied the enemy. Beyond the rifle, Biafra relied heavily on home-made mines, wire entanglement and bamboo and timber anti-vehicle obstacles, and on captured 4.2-inch and 20-pounder guns and vehicle-mounted launchers. Transport on both sides depended on lorries, motorcycles and dugout canoes, and fuel and tyres were a tighter constraint than the guns themselves.
tactics: 兩軍的戰術形態由地形決定。奈及利亞東部的交通網極稀，公路只餘一條拉各斯—伊巴丹—卡諾的主幹與數條東線支線，鐵路止於翁加與奧尼查，因此聯邦軍只能靠縱隊車隊沿路推進，縱深補給全押在公路上，雨季一旦沖毀路面，前線就會停頓。聯邦軍的戰法是多路縱進、後方跟進：步兵師沿公路成縱隊行軍，裝甲與砲兵提供火力，工程兵沿途修復橋梁，佔領一地即設一個前進補給點；1967年秋的攻勢在恩古至奧尼查的走廊上受挫之後，聯邦軍轉為穩紮穩打，以砲火準備配合逐點攻擊，晝夜以砲火與空襲壓制，再以步兵佔領。比夫拉軍則以守點與游擊交替：初期守軍在恩古、阿巴、奧韋里沿公路與城郊構築野戰陣地，用交叉火力封鎖路口；1968年後轉為以游擊為主的戰法，小分隊多為數十人，隱蔽在稻田、叢林與廢墟之中，專打聯邦軍的車隊、指揮所與砲兵陣地，用地雷與竹木障礙遲滲車隊，再在聯邦軍推進時退入村落，打成村莊爭奪戰。空軍方面，馮·羅森的B-25轟炸機在夜間襲擊恩古一帶，跑道與油庫屢遭破壞，聯邦空軍則以日間出擊與低空巡邏攔截，驅逐並攔截比夫拉的夜間空襲。命令傳遞依靠步行信使、無線電與長途電話線，效率低，各師協同不佳。1970年後段，聯邦軍以砲火與封鎖切斷各據點之間的往來，逐點拔除殘餘抵抗。
tacticsEn: The tactical shape of both armies was dictated by the terrain. The transport net in eastern Nigeria was extremely thin, with only the Lagos–Ibadan–Kano trunk road and a handful of eastern branches, while the railway stopped at Onitsha and Enugu, so the federal army could only advance in road columns and its entire reach depended on the highways; whenever the rains washed out a road the front stalled. The federal method was to advance on several axes with the follow-up echelon behind: infantry divisions marched in column along the roads, armour and artillery provided the firepower, engineers repaired bridges on the line of march, and every place taken became a forward supply point. After the offensive of the autumn of 1967 was checked in the Enugu–Onitsha corridor, the federal army settled into a methodical pattern, using artillery preparation with attacks point by point, applying gunfire and air strikes day and night and then occupying with infantry. The Biafran army alternated between holding ground and raiding. In the opening phase the defenders built field positions along the roads and on the outskirts of Enugu, Aba and Owerri, sealing the junctions with crossfire; after 1968 the pattern shifted to a guerrilla-dominant mode, with small sections of a few dozen men concealed in paddy, jungle and ruins, striking federal columns, command posts and gun positions, using mines and timber obstacles to delay armour, and then falling back into the villages as the federals advanced, so that the war became a series of village sieges. In the air, von Rosen's B-25 bombers attacked the Enugu area at night, repeatedly wrecking runways and fuel dumps, while the federal air force flew by day and patrolled the low altitudes to break up and intercept the night sorties. Orders moved by foot messenger, radio and long-distance telephone line, which was slow and left the divisions poorly coordinated. In the closing months of 1970 the federal army cut the links between the remaining strongholds with gunfire and blockade, and reduced them one by one.
data: 時間與空間：戰爭自1967年7月6日開打，1970年1月12日埃豐貢在恩古簽署終戰文件，主要戰事歷時約30個月；若計入其後零星抵抗，到1970年12月奧朱古正式投降為止，前後超過兩年九個月。戰區是奈及利亞東部三省，比夫拉實際控制面積約5萬平方公里，約占全國土地面積的5%，控制人口約550萬，約占當時奈及利亞總人口的十分之一。兵力：聯邦軍全國總兵力逾15萬人，東南戰區常在前線的兵力約6萬至7萬，編制為三至四個步兵師、若干裝甲營與空降旅；比夫拉軍號稱總兵力約7萬人，實際持有武器並受過訓練者不足3萬，其中第一師為骨幹，兵力約1.3萬，是全軍裝備與訓練最好的部隊。武器：1968年之前比夫拉幾乎沒有AK-47，1968年下半年至1969年間由捷克斯洛伐克與蘇聯等渠道成批運抵的蘇制步槍以數千支計；蘇聯在1968年後亦向聯邦交付蘇制步槍、RPG-7與122毫米榴炮。損失：聯邦軍陣亡人數的估計差距甚大，約500至2000人不等，早期最慘重的損失出現在初期的攻勢與隨軍空降分隊；比夫拉軍人陣亡常估2萬至3萬人；聯邦空軍在地面炮火下損失飛機約9架，比夫拉空軍損失1架B-25轟炸機與1架DC-3，馮·羅森在兩年內出動約百次。封鎖效果：聯邦海軍攔截了數以百計駛近比夫拉港口的外國船隻，進口物資由海運轉為空投，彈藥與燃料的到貨量成為全戰役最關鍵的瓶頸。
dataEn: Time and space. The war opened on 6 July 1967, and the end-of-war document was signed by Effiong at Enugu on 12 January 1970, so the main phase of the fighting ran for about thirty months; counting the scattered resistance that followed, the war was not over until Ojukwu surrendered in December 1970, a total of more than two years and nine months. The theatre was the three eastern provinces of Nigeria. Biafra actually held an area of roughly 50,000 square kilometres, about 5 per cent of the national land surface, and a population of some 5.5 million, close to one tenth of Nigeria's people at the time. Manpower. The federal army numbered over 150,000 on its national establishment, with roughly 60,000 to 70,000 normally deployed on the south-eastern front, organised into three or four infantry divisions with armoured battalions and an airborne brigade. Biafra claimed a total force of about 70,000, but the number actually holding weapons and trained was under 30,000, of which the 1st Division was the core, a formation of about 13,000 men and the best equipped and trained in the whole army. Weapons. Before 1968 Biafra had virtually no AK-47s; the Soviet rifles that arrived in bulk between the second half of 1968 and 1969 through Czechoslovak and Soviet channels ran into the thousands, and from 1968 the Soviet Union also delivered AK-47s, RPG-7 launchers and 122mm howitzers to the federal side. Losses. Estimates of federal military deaths vary widely, from about 500 to 2,000, the heaviest early losses falling in the opening offensives and in the airborne detachments that went in with the columns; Biafran military deaths are commonly put at 20,000 to 30,000. The federal air force lost about nine aircraft to ground fire, while the Biafran air arm lost one B-25 bomber and one DC-3, with von Rosen flying close to a hundred missions in two years. Effect of the blockade. The federal navy intercepted several hundred foreign ships approaching Biafran ports, so that imported materiel moved from the sea route to the air drop, and the volume of ammunition and fuel actually arriving became the single most critical constraint of the whole war.
cause: 直接導火線是一串不到十二個月的連鎖政變。1966年1月15日，青年軍官推翻民選的巴萊瓦總理政府，尼日利亞北部出身的軍人取得聯邦權力；同年5至6月，因全國單一制與聯邦首都遷都的爭議，北方士兵針對南部與中部出身的軍官大規模清洗，使聯邦軍內部的族群裂痕定型；7月北方軍人推翻加冕的總統埃德溫·姆班埃基與內閣，改由北方軍人組成的最高軍事委員會掌權，聯邦制在改組為12個州後已名存實亡。1966年10月1日，聯邦政府把軍隊與警察開支削減一半，聯邦軍自此出現指揮鏈分裂，東部駐軍另尋出路。1967年5月30日，聯邦政府以叛國罪逮捕東部十二名高級軍官並由特別法庭判處死刑，其中包括少將凱塔與上校奧朱古，其後數人被秘密處決，說法不一；6月聯邦軍向東部推進收繳武器，軍營衝突蔓延，和平解決的可能斷送。1967年7月6日，奧朱古在恩古廣播宣布東部獨立，比夫拉人保衛家園；聯邦軍同日自阿薩巴渡口強渡尼日爾河向恩古進攻，內戰全面爆發。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was a chain of coups compressed into less than twelve months. On 15 January 1966 young army officers overthrew the elected government of Prime Minister Balewa, and officers from the northern parts of Nigeria took control of the federation. In May and June of the same year, disputes over a unitary state and over moving the federal capital produced a sweeping purge of southern and central officers by northern soldiers, fixing the ethnic fracture inside the federal army. In July the northern officers removed the crowned president, Edwin Mbanefo, and his cabinet, and a Supreme Military Council of northern officers took over; the federal arrangement had been hollowed out by the reorganisation into twelve states. On 1 October 1966 the federal government halved the spending on the army and the police, and from that point the chain of federal command broke down, with the eastern garrisons looking for another way. On 30 May 1967 the federal government arrested twelve senior eastern officers on charges of treason and sentenced them to death by a special tribunal, among them Major-General Keita and Colonel Ojukwu; several of them were afterwards put to death out of sight, though the details are disputed. In June federal troops moved into the east to confiscate weapons, the friction in the barracks spread, and the prospect of a peaceful settlement was destroyed. On 6 July 1967 Ojukwu broadcast from Enugu declaring the eastern provinces independent and calling on Biafrans to defend their homes, and on the same day the federal army forced the Niger River at Asaba to advance on Enugu. The civil war was fully under way.
impact: 這場戰爭終結了奈及利亞的聯邦爭議，卻把族群問題推入更長的年代。聯邦軍取得東南全境，比夫拉作為國家主體消失，奈及利亞維持了單一國家的框架，其後由軍人執政：1975年軍事政變後軍隊退下政治舞臺，國家重回文官統治。戰爭帶來的另一項後果是財政結構的重塑，石油收入在戰後成為聯邦財政的主要支柱，奈及利亞於1971年成為石油輸出國組織的創始成員之一。軍隊方面，聯邦軍完成英美蘇裝備的混編，空軍現代化，蘇製MiG-21於1970年間到貨，並以戰爭經驗催生快速反應部隊，成為陸軍精銳骨幹；比夫拉軍則整建失敗，國防軍解散，軍人大量復員返鄉或編入聯邦軍與警察。族群層面的代價最為長遠：戰後伊博族人口大批被迫離鄉、流散各地，族群在全國的佔比明顯下降，不滿與邊緣化感受此後長期存在，成為奈及利亞政治中的長期變數；東部重建緩慢，收益分配與地區失衡的爭議從未平息。國際層面上，比夫拉是冷戰時期非洲最著名的代理戰之一，宗主國英國支持聯邦，蘇聯支持比夫拉，顯示冷戰已深入非洲；聯合國未能有效介入，封鎖造成的饑荒與人道災難引發學界與傳媒的長期爭議，至今仍是討論圍堵政策時的常被引用案例。比夫拉流亡政府設於貝寧帕拉庫，1976年被要求解散；奧朱古2006年獲邀回國並獲赦免，2010年病逝拉各斯。
impactEn: The war settled the federal question in Nigeria but pushed the ethnic problem into a far longer era. The federal army took the entire south-east, Biafra ceased to exist as a state, and Nigeria kept the framework of a single country under military government; after the 1975 coup the army withdrew from politics and the country returned to civilian rule. A second legacy was the reshaping of the public finances, with oil revenue becoming the main pillar of federal income after the war and Nigeria appearing as a founding member of OPEC in 1971. On the military side the federal army completed a mixed British, American and Soviet re-armament, the air force modernised with Soviet MiG-21s arriving around 1970, and the experience of the war produced the rapid reaction force that became the core of the army's professional strength. The Biafran army failed to survive as an institution: the defence force was dissolved, and large numbers of its soldiers were demobilised back to their villages or taken into the federal army and police. The most lasting cost was ethnic. After the war the Igbo population was driven from its homeland in large numbers and dispersed, its share of the national population fell sharply, and the sense of exclusion has remained a lasting feature of Nigerian politics, while reconstruction in the east was slow and the argument over the distribution of oil revenue was never settled. Internationally, Biafra became one of the best known proxy wars of the Cold War in Africa: the former colonial power, Britain, backed the federation and the Soviet Union backed Biafra, showing how deeply the Cold War had reached the continent. The United Nations was unable to intervene effectively, and the famine and humanitarian disaster produced by the blockade brought long-running academic and press controversy, and the case is still cited whenever blockade policy is discussed. The Biafran government-in-exile sat at Parakou in Benin and was required to disband in 1976; Ojukwu returned to Nigeria on invitation in 2006 and was pardoned, and died in Lagos in 2010.
result: 聯邦軍逐點收復。1967年下半年比夫拉軍攻勢凌厲，聯邦軍節節失守，恩古與阿巴相繼淪陷，前線退到三角地帶；1968年10月聯邦軍奪回恩古，1969年推進至奧韋里與蒙羅比亞一線，比夫拉退守三角洲與奧榮瓜一帶的據點作困守。1970年1月1日，第四師師長維克多·烏卡瓦上校在蒙羅比亞的空襲中陣亡；1月4日第三師師長大衛·埃朱爾上校率殘部及港口守軍投降，蒙羅比亞陷落，聯邦軍攻入三角洲核心，比夫拉政權失去主要城市與港口。1月11日至12日，參謀長菲利普·埃豐貢在恩古與聯邦軍簽署終戰文件，規定國防軍解散、武器繳交、人員復員並部分重新編入聯邦軍，同時獲得人身安全保證，主要戰事至此結束。1970年12月，奧朱古在伊科特埃凱內向聯邦軍代表正式投降，零星抵抗完全熄滅，戰爭以分離主義失敗、聯邦統一完成告終。聯邦軍取勝的關鍵在四點：制空權與砲火準備壓制對方據點；公路補給線逐段打通，使後方火力能持續前推；蘇英美武器供應充足，1970年前後換裝蘇制AK-47與RPG-7後火力與續行能力提升；以逐步合圍與游擊消耗對方指揮骨幹與士氣，終結其抵抗意志。
resultEn: The federal army took ground point by point. In the second half of 1967 the Biafran offensive was fierce and the federals were driven back repeatedly, losing Enugu and Aba and falling to the eastern triangle; in October 1968 the federal army retook Enugu, and in 1969 it pushed through to the Owerri and Port Harcourt line while Biafra contracted into its remaining strongholds in the delta and around Orongwu. On 1 January 1970 Colonel Victor Ukaoha, commanding the 4th Division, was killed in an air raid on Port Harcourt, and on 4 January Colonel David Ejoor of the 3rd Division surrendered with the remnants of his command and the port garrison; Port Harcourt fell, the federal army entered the heart of the delta, and the Biafran state lost its principal cities and its port. Between 11 and 12 January the chief of staff Philip Effiong signed the end-of-war document with the federal government at Enugu, providing for the dissolution of the defence force, the surrender of weapons, demobilisation and the absorption of part of the personnel into the federal army, together with guarantees of personal safety, and the main phase of the war was over. In December 1970 Ojukwu formally surrendered to the federal representatives at Ikot Ekpene, the last scattered resistance died out, and the war ended with the defeat of secession and the completion of federal unity. Four factors carried the federal victory: air superiority and artillery preparation to pin the opposing strongpoints; the gradual opening of the road supply line so that rear-area firepower could keep moving forward; ample British, American and Soviet resupply, the switch to Soviet AK-47s and RPG-7s around 1970 raising both firepower and endurance; and a combination of encirclement and raiding that wore down the enemy command structure and will, so that the will to resist drained away.
